usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/speech-to-text with multipart/form-data fields: model_id=scribe_v1 + file=<audio binary> (NOT JSON)
usage.outputShape: unknown — never received a 2xx (server rejected JSON body before transcription)
quirks: Endpoint is a multipart/form-data proxy to ElevenLabs Scribe, NOT a JSON endpoint.
Required field model_id (e.g. scribe_v1) plus the audio in a multipart 'file' field (100ms minimum audio).
A JSON request body is ignored entirely: the server's validator reports input:null and 422 'model_id field required' even when model_id IS present in the JSON.
source_url / cloud_storage_url are documented in the registry inputSchema but were NOT honored when sent in a JSON body (same 422).
The money-safe JSON x402 pay primitive (qa-pay) cannot call this endpoint — it hard-codes Content-Type: application/json and JSON-stringifies the body, so it cannot build multipart with a file part.

x402 charges $0.030 USDC on Base BEFORE the multipart validation runs, so a JSON call pays then 422s with no refund (lost $0.03 in this test, tx 0xddab6aeb849c909426d2dc0e1e83ace7d3851e04d57c24ec53d8746971c5ce31).
usage.guide: Call POST https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/speech-to-text as multipart/form-data, not JSON. Send form field model_id=scribe_v1 and the audio as the file form field (at least 100ms of audio); optional fields: diarize, language_code, tag_audio_events, num_speakers, timestamps_granularity. Pay the $0.030 x402 USDC charge on Base. Do NOT send a JSON body — the server ignores it and returns 422 after charging you. A JSON-only x402 client (like the qa-pay primitive) cannot use this endpoint; you need a client that can build multipart bodies with the x402 payment header attached.
